Verso: "#2" [followed by illegible word] (unidentified hand, graphite). Backing: 1. OK {5star} [star written by Alfred Stieglitz] (black crayon) 2. "Special No [number obscured] / for OK to sign" (Alfred Stieglitz, black crayon); 3. "By Georgia O'Keeffe / 1918" (Alfred Stieglitz, black crayon) 
(Source: Lynes, 1999)

materials.content:
Charcoal on moderately thick, cream, slightly textured wove paper
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1993 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscriptions 1, 3. Backing inscription dates 1918. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1918. Dated 1919 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 18. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive.
titles.title: Special #39

description: Two small black circles peek out from two vertical lines that resemble slits in a piece of fabric or paper. These central forms contrast with a plain white background that spans most of the composition.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Museum of Modern Art (MoMA).
